title: SRD: righting yourself ends the Prone condition, so a creature that isn't Prone has nothing to end; engine: refuses but cites no page

history.summary: Fixed T-44. When a creature that isn't Prone tries to stand up, `stand_up` in dungdra/combat.py still refuses, but the refusal now cites page=186 and rule="GLOSS.prone#2": righting yourself is what ends the condition, so there's nothing to end. I also gave the other two refusals in `stand_up` their clause numbers (Speed 0 is #3, too little movement left is #2) and tagged them with SRD comments. I added 3 unit tests. Results: all 351 unit tests pass, the ticket's test passes with --runxfail, ruff check and ruff format are clean, and dev-gate passes. With --runxfail, test_cant_stand_up_for_free_on_another_creatures_turn still fails; that one belongs to T-45, which is a separate ticket and is still marked xfail.
